consequences.explanation: The isolation contract remains accepted meaning across future backend replacements.

payload.decision: Use the existing bubblewrap contract through a WSL launcher on native Windows and directly on Linux/WSL. Pin the distribution and Linux Node, forward only allowed environment values, translate typed path inputs, preserve opaque argv, mount frozen validator sources read-only, deny network, and clean the process tree. Return actionable unavailable evidence when prerequisites or probes fail. Native npm sandbox alternatives are reconsiderable once the complete published contract is demonstrated.
payload.title: Use WSL bubblewrap from native Windows and bubblewrap directly on Linux
